messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm planning a targeted unpin of runtime v3.1 for model-group 'summarize' in eu-west tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. low risk but want cross-stack signoff.
raj: Quick question — does this also require unpinning the sdk shim (sdk 2.7) or is runtime-only?
olivia: My read from the compatibility matrix: runtime v3.1 -> sdk 2.7 stays OK, but older model variants (summarize-legacy) will break. We should limit traffic using routing rules.
tess: +1 on routing. Can we add a soft-fallback to summarize-v2 (quant) for 5% of traffic in case of regressions?
maria: Yes — propose phased roll: 90% runtime v3.1 unpin -> 5% reroute to summarize-v2 -> 5% holdback to pinned runtime. If metrics stable after 15m we widen.
deploybot: @channel deploybot report: pending action — "unpin-runtime" requires deploy approval and a deploybot pin-exception check. Run `/deploy plan unpin runtime=3.1 group=summarize region=eu-west` to preview.
raj: Running preview now...
raj: Output:
```
Plan: unpin runtime=3.1
Affected: 12 clusters in eu-west
Auto-fallbacks: summarize-v2 (quant) available
Canary rollout: configured
Prechecks: telemetry hooks, perf-snapshots, eval-set-1
```

olivia: Telemetry hooks good. Perf snapshots show ~1.2% latency drop after previous unpins.
tess: Eval-set-1 pass rate was 98% for summarize-v2 vs 99% baseline. Need to watch for semantic drift.
maria: SRE oncall: any concerns about capacity for short 5% reroute to quant model?
srebot: Capacity check OK — quant instances have spare slots, CPU headroom 25%. No quota issues.
raj: One more ask — include a rollback trigger: if token-error-rate > 0.5% OR user-facing regression score degrades by >1.5 points in 10m, auto-roll back to pinned runtime. Can deploybot attach that?
deploybot: Acknowledged. Use `/deploy with-triggers --rollback "ter>0.5% or drift>1.5"` as part of the plan. Will emit alerts to #eng-runtime and page SRE if triggered.
maria: OK locking the plan: rollout at 22:15 UTC, phased 10/30/60/100 over 30m, fallback to summarize-v2 for 5% initially. If no regression after 30m, widen to 100%. Rollback triggers as stated.
tess: @maria please add a short release note blurb for ops-dashboard: "Unpin runtime v3.1 for summarize group in eu-west. Phased rollout, auto-fallback to summarize-v2 quant. Rollback thresholds configured."
maria: Added release note in docs/release-notes/3610009999-unpin-summary-eu-west.md (internal).
olivia: I'll shadow traffic and run nightly evals.
raj: Approved from infra side.
srebot: deploybot scheduled at 2026-03-21T22:15:00Z (3610010100). Change window flagged.
maria: Thanks — proceeding unless anyone objects in next 10m. :thumbsup:
